::: {#rem-instruction-tuning}

#### From predicting text to following instructions

A [pretrained](attention-transformers.qmd#def-pretraining) [language model](language-models.qmd#def-language-model) continues text;
it does not answer a question
just because it is asked one.
@ouyang2022training [fine-tune](cnns.qmd#def-fine-tuning) GPT-3 in two stages to follow instructions.
First they train it on prompts paired with answers that people wrote.
Then people rank several of the model's answers to each prompt, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
a second network learns to predict those rankings,
and [reinforcement learning](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/anatomy.html#def-reinforcement) trains the model toward answers that the second network rates highly.
The second stage is reinforcement learning from human feedback, or RLHF.

:::
